status_note: Manifest created mid-run per explicit instruction not to interrupt training. Fields below marked null/"unknown — not recorded" are pending or unrecoverable and will be filled in after completion by re-editing this same file (not superseded by a new run-id, since it documents this one run).
manifest_schema_note: All values are measured from the live process, git history, and on-disk config at audit time (2026-08-09T08:5x UTC), not reconstructed from defaults. Anything not directly observable is explicitly null with an explanation, per instruction not to fabricate.

provenance.git_working_tree_dirty_note: `git status --short` was clean immediately before this run was launched (last commit 0ea791b, pushed, then src/09_loop.py synced and the loop launched in the same minute). No local uncommitted changes existed at launch time.
provenance.launch_command_note: Run via: cd /root/schemaforge_v2 && source /root/venv/bin/activate && nohup python3 src/09_loop.py --eval-jsonl data/eval_holdout.jsonl --state-file logs/loop_state.jsonl --max-iterations 1 > logs/09_loop_iter0.log 2>&1 & disown
config_files_used: no external config file — all hyperparameters are literal constants inside src/01_generate_teacher.py and src/02_train_distill.py (this repo's convention: standalone numbered scripts, no config-file layer). See training_configuration below for the exact values read directly from those files at this commit.
provenance.cli_overrides_of_defaults: none — src/01_generate_teacher.py and src/02_train_distill.py take no CLI arguments; src/09_loop.py's own CLI args only control corpus generation (n_per_schema=30 [default], severities=0.0,0.3,0.6,0.9 [default], seed=42 [default]) and eval-jsonl/state-file paths, all left at their defaults for this run except --eval-jsonl and --state-file (both required, no default to override).

hardware_environment.compute_attribution: GPU access provided by the AMD AI Developer Program. This statement documents the compute source; it is not a claim of AMD endorsement or review of the research.
hardware_environment.shared_gpu_note: This GPU/server is shared with a second, independently-operated agent session running unrelated ComfyUI/image-generation workloads during this run. VRAM was not contended (this job used <1/3 of the 192GB total); GPU compute utilization was occasionally shared, which may have modestly lengthened wall-clock duration versus an exclusive run — recorded as a caveat, not a fabricated throughput number.

student_model.parameter_count_estimate_note: Computed from config.json architecture dimensions (embedding + per-layer attention/MLP projections x24 layers, untied input/output embeddings), not measured via a live model.numel() call — flagged as an estimate, not a measured fact.
student_model.tokenizer_identifier: openbmb/MiniCPM5-1B (same repo as the model; no separate tokenizer repo)
student_model.tokenizer_revision: unknown — not pinned, same caveat as student_model.revision

dataset.source: schemaforge.hardexamples.generate (this repo's own deterministic hard-example generator; not an external/published dataset)
dataset.schemas_included: all 9 training schemas (held-out schemas insurance_claim/conversation/kg_triple excluded by --split train)
dataset.operators: default (all ten corruption operators; --operators not overridden)
dataset.corpus_size_note: sha256 matches the corpus used for the prior (iteration-5) run byte-for-byte, confirming the generator's determinism claim (same seed/params -> identical output).
dataset.teacher_output_dataset: data/teacher_dataset.json, written by src/01_generate_teacher.py after the §4.2 validation gate (schemaforge/validation/gate.py) — admitted count pending, this stage was still running at manifest-creation time
dataset.train_val_test_split: no held-out validation/test split within the admitted training set — the model trains on 100% of gate-admitted examples; evaluation is against a SEPARATE eval corpus (data/eval_holdout.jsonl, 72 records spanning all 12 schemas including the 3 held-out ones) generated independently, not a split of the training corpus.
dataset.preprocessing_filtering: schemaforge/validation/gate.py's 4-step gate (JSON parse, Pydantic schema validation, source-support/ontology-derivation check, no-over-assertion check) is the only filtering; rejected examples are logged with reasons, not silently dropped, per logs/V2_TRAINING_FAILURES.md practice.

training_configuration.read_from: src/02_train_distill.py at commit 0ea791b (literal constants, no config file)
training_configuration.distillation_method: sequence-level knowledge distillation (cross-entropy on validated teacher outputs); NOT logit-level KL divergence — the cross-tokenizer logit KL used in the superseded V1 approach was found invalid (mismatched teacher/student tokenizers) and explicitly not carried forward, per docs/PROJECT_CHARTER.md §7.1
training_configuration.loss_function: torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss(ignore_index=-100), prompt tokens masked to -100 so only completion (teacher_json) tokens contribute to loss
training_configuration.teacher_loss_weighting_alpha_beta: not applicable — no teacher forward pass or logit mixing at train time; teacher outputs are consumed purely as text labels for CE, generated offline in a separate stage
training_configuration.temperature: not applicable to this CE-only objective (no softmax-temperature distillation term)
training_configuration.max_training_steps: not fixed — derived as len(dataloader) * 3 epochs; len(dataloader) depends on the gate-admitted example count, unknown until the teacher stage completes
training_configuration.precision: bf16 if torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported() else fp16 (resolved at runtime by resolve_device_and_dtype(); MI300X supports bf16, so bf16 is expected — not yet confirmed from this run's own stdout since the retrain stage had not started at audit time)
training_configuration.gradient_checkpointing: not enabled (no gradient_checkpointing_enable() call in src/02_train_distill.py)
training_configuration.attention_implementation: unknown — not explicitly set; whatever transformers' AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained default resolves to for this architecture/dtype on ROCm (no attn_implementation= argument passed)
training_configuration.random_seed_training: unknown — not recorded. src/02_train_distill.py does not call torch.manual_seed()/set a seed before training; DataLoader(shuffle=True) uses whatever the process's default RNG state is at that point, which is not deterministic/reproducible as written. This is a real reproducibility gap in the current script, not an omission of this manifest.
training_configuration.checkpoint_frequency: single checkpoint at the end of all 3 epochs (student.save_pretrained(OUTPUT_DIR) called once, after the full training loop — no intermediate epoch checkpoints saved)
training_configuration.evaluation_frequency: no in-loop evaluation — evaluation happens as a separate subsequent stage (src/08_hybrid_eval.py, src/07_failure_eval.py) after training completes, not interleaved with training steps
training_configuration.checkpoint_dir_note: This path OVERWRITES the prior (iteration-5) checkpoint at the same location — unlike prior manual iterations in this project, src/02_train_distill.py itself does not rename/preserve the previous checkpoint before writing (that renaming was done manually by the operator before each prior manual run, e.g. `mv ... _iter3_166doc`). Whether that manual preservation step was performed before THIS run is recorded in the training_report.md's deviations section.

training_performance.start_timestamp_note: Process start time from `ps -o lstart` on amd-training-2 for PID 22810 (src/01_generate_teacher.py, the first GPU-bound stage the loop launches).
training_performance.tokens_per_second: unknown — not instrumented in src/02_train_distill.py or src/01_generate_teacher.py; would require adding timing/token-counting code, which was not done to avoid modifying the active run
training_performance.peak_vram_note: Point-in-time VRAM readings were taken via rocm-smi during the run for operational monitoring (see logs/V2_TRAINING_FAILURES.md and this session's chat log), not a continuous peak-tracking instrument — the single highest reading observed during the teacher-generation stage was ~76.7GB used GPU-wide (shared with the other agent's idle-but-resident ComfyUI process), not a peak specific to this job alone.
training_performance.final_validation_loss: not applicable — no validation split (see dataset.train_val_test_split)
training_performance.distillation_specific_loss_values: not applicable — single CE loss only, no separate distillation-term breakdown to report

This file will be updated in place (same run_id) once the run finishes, per instruction not to fabricate or wait to publish partial results.
